newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY'S FORINT ENDS DOWN VS DLR, BACK ON NBH BID.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY'S FORINT ENDS DOWN VS DLR, BACK ON NBH BID.

text.p: Hungary's forint eased against the dollar on Wednesday and closed right on the central bank's resistance level (bid) after opening a gap in hectic morning trade.
The forint ended at 180.75/80 to one dollar, down from 180.42/47 at midday.
"Most of today activity was confined to early trading," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank.
The forint left the central bank's bid opening a 30 pips gap in early trade due to heavy forex buying but most market players retreated by midday and the forint closed the gap, traders added.
(National Bank of Hungary (NBH) basket: 30 pct dollar + 70 pct mark. The NBH's intervention range is 4.5 percent wide.)
